description.zh: 把节点的实时状态做成图片：小徽章、单节点卡片和全部节点的状态看板，有 SVG、PNG、JPEG 和会自己刷新的 MJPEG 实时流，可以贴到 README、论坛签名或网站里。
description.en: Live node status as images: small badges, a card per node and a board of all nodes, as SVG, PNG, JPEG or a self-refreshing MJPEG stream, to embed in a README, a forum signature or a site.

help.zh: 生成嵌入代码时用它代替 <站点地址>/api/plugin/status-image，例如 https://img.example.com 或 https://example.com/status。需要自己在反向代理里把这个地址转发到 /api/plugin/status-image/。留空则使用站点地址。
help.en: Used instead of <site address>/api/plugin/status-image in the embed code, e.g. https://img.example.com or https://example.com/status. Your reverse proxy has to forward it to /api/plugin/status-image/. Leave empty to use the site address.

name.zh: 状态看板最多显示的节点数
name.en: Most nodes shown on the board

name.zh: 在卡片和看板上显示 CPU、内存、磁盘和网速
name.en: Show CPU, memory, disk and network on cards and the board

help.zh: 关闭后图片只显示在线状态和可用率。
help.en: When off, images show only whether nodes are up and their availability.

help.zh: 实时流在被查看期间每隔几秒重画一次，一直占用一条连接，同一时间最多 32 路，每路最长 1 小时。
help.en: A live stream draws itself again every few seconds while it is on screen and keeps a connection open: at most 32 at a time, each for up to an hour.

name.zh: 实时流最短刷新间隔（秒）
name.en: Shortest refresh of a live stream (seconds)

help.zh: 地址里要求的刷新间隔不能比它短。1–60。
help.en: An interval asked for in the address cannot be shorter. 1-60.
